literal: Him who has attained the state where his own soul is severed from ego, all other abiding living beings will worship.
translation: All other living beings will worship him who has attained complete mastery over his own soul by severing it from egoistic attachment.
modern: தன் உயிரை தன் முனைப்பு அல்லது அகந்தை நீங்குமாறு ஆளப் பெற்றவனை, உலகில் நிலைபெற்றுள்ள மற்ற எல்லா உயிர்களும் வணங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the spiritual power and universal reverence achieved through true penance. The phrase 'tannuyir tān aṟa' refers to severing the ego or the false sense of 'I' (tāṉ) from one's own soul (uyir). When an ascetic achieves this state of complete self-mastery and detachment, they transcend ordinary human limitations. Consequently, all other living beings ('maṉṉuyir ellām') in the world will naturally revere and bow down to them.
